tasks.short: Start metering pumps and monitor filament processing

steps.what: Check the actual authorized run, metering-pump identity and existing machine-ready indications before the start command
inputs: OPS_SYSTEM: existing fiber-extrusion machine control panel
Actual authorized run and identified metering pump
Existing machine-ready indications and work procedures
outputs: Exact intended start command and actual equipment readiness checked by the operator

steps.what: Start the actual metering pump using the exact checked command through the existing machine controls
inputs: Exact start command and equipment readiness checked in s1
Matching actual pump and authorized run

steps.what: Observe actual machine and equipment operation, filament flow through spinnerettes and processing defects
inputs: Actual operating machines and filament flow
outputs: Actual observation of continuous filament flow and detected processing defects

tasks.design: Retain the existing {OPS_SYSTEM} machine controls and indications. Separate the operator's actual readiness check, exact start command and physical process observation; no additional digital change is established for this task.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual pump control and observation of filament processing are physical operating work.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing machine controls and alarms are already part of today's operation; the supplied evidence does not establish a new mechanism that replaces the remaining operator observations.
tasks.still_hard: Actual filament flow and processing defects depend on live equipment and physical material conditions.
tasks.human_edge: The operator observes the real process and retains control over starting the identified equipment.

ambition.what: No new software change proposed for this actual operating task.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: existing machine controls and alarms do not by themselves establish that all physical filament-flow and defect observations can be removed from an operator's work.

assumptions: Unmeasured actual machine-start and observation episode; shares are independently sized and do not use the prompt's time-share prior. A machines-class task is not evidence of a new labor saving.

The actual production assignment and existing controls provide run and equipment identity. s1 counts the operator's ordinary readiness and exact-command check, not an invented extra management approval. s2 is the separate human-controlled start action; new equipment conditions or changed commands require a renewed check.

Existing metering, process regulation, interlocks, alarms and unattended machine runtime are baseline. No new vision system, sensor, inferred process state, control parameter or autonomous machine intervention is proposed.

The statement requires starting and observation, not a separate report or record entry. No operator-authored log, defect notification, adjustment command or maintenance transaction is established in this episode; such actual work would need its own steps and gates rather than being assumed free.
After separating the actual control action and observation, no supported new change remains. Gross and net saving are zero, with no new implementation or upkeep.
unknowns: Whether a specific plant has unlogged manual defect observations suitable for a separately tested sensing change
Whether a particular operating episode includes a required defect record or control adjustment
research_questions: Which physical defects are not already indicated by the existing control system?
Does the operator actually perform a separate required record or send action during this task?

already_counted.description: Existing operator readiness and exact-start-command checking retained in full

incremental.description: No new change or maintenance is proposed; existing machine operation and observation remain unchanged

approvals.approved_version: Exact metering-pump start command, actual equipment identity and readiness checked in s1; changed conditions or command require renewed checking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 unmeasured assessment: readiness 5, actual start 1 and process observation 94 are retained in full. Existing machine automation is baseline, not a new labor saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

reach: Production and machine-control owners supply the actual authorized run and existing equipment indications.
skills_to_grow: Distinguish existing machine automation from a new reduction in operator work
role.ambitious_version: An operator who retains actual equipment control and physical process observation; no new digital intervention is justified by this task's evidence.

job.title: Extruding and Forming Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Synthetic and Glass Fibers
